answer: Agents join a shared lagoon of issued credentials; each harbor maintains an anonymized credential revocation list (ACRL) of burned or sold identities as hashed nullifiers. Before any action, a client proves non-membership in that ACRL via a compact bloom or sparse-Merkle witness so recycled sybils are rejected without revealing which credential was checked. The ACRL grows like a timber ledger of cuts: once revoked, an identity cannot regrow into the economy.
